results.description: GTIG’s February 2026 edition described AI primarily as a productivity accelerator for reconnaissance, social engineering, and malware development, and stated that GTIG had not yet seen evidence of autonomous agent capabilities being used in the wild [3]. The November 16, 2026 edition, titled “Agentic Threat Activity Crosses a Significant Threshold,” reverses that position on the basis of the exploit_agent discovery [1].
